skills.name: workflow-state-manager
skills.description: Persist session state, checkpoints, artifacts, decisions, and events.

skills.name: academic-search-multisource
skills.description: Search scholarly sources selected explicitly in the sources array, normalize results, screen them, and create a paper pool. Available source values are openalex, semantic_scholar, crossref, pubmed, and arxiv. The model chooses the sources for the current task; the service has no hidden default or fallback order.

skills.name: literature-screening
skills.description: Deduplicate and filter the active paper pool with transparent relevance reasons.

skills.name: literature-matrix-extraction
skills.description: Summarize active papers and build a grounded evidence matrix.

skills.name: experiment-data-analysis
skills.description: Analyze CSV, TSV, XLSX, or text experiment data.

skills.name: scientific-chart
skills.description: Render an explicit line, scatter, bar, histogram, box, or heatmap specification from tabular data and return a PNG or SVG artifact.

skills.name: data-transform
skills.description: Transform experiment data by normalizing, filtering missing rows, keeping columns, and saving a new file.

skills.name: reference-format-gbt7714
skills.description: Format references in Nature, IEEE, APA, ACS, GB/T 7714, and 14 other journal styles. Accepts DOCX, JSON, BibTeX, or RIS input and produces a formatted Word document.

skills.name: systematic-literature-review
skills.description: Generate a grounded review outline or draft from the active paper pool.

skills.name: read-arxiv-paper
skills.description: Read one arXiv paper from a URL or identifier.

skills.name: 20-ml-paper-writing
skills.description: Draft evidence-backed ML paper sections from session artifacts.

skills.name: manuscript-writing
skills.description: Create a complete evidence-audited manuscript draft from user material and any relevant session artifacts. The model chooses when to use it; no fixed search or writing sequence is required.

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Export a Markdown file to a Word document (.docx). Not for reading or converting DOCX files.

skills.name: document-convert
skills.description: Convert DOCX to Markdown or Markdown to DOCX with imported source, media extraction, and a fidelity report.

skills.name: document-summary
skills.description: Explain an explicitly supplied DOCX or Markdown document in Chinese, save a grounded summary artifact, and return the summary directly.

skills.name: doc-coauthoring
skills.description: Revise an existing research artifact from user feedback.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.description: Edit research prose to remove formulaic model language.

skills.name: canvas-design
skills.description: Create a specification for a research diagram or visual asset.

skills.name: literature-search-openalex
skills.description: Search OpenAlex only.

skills.name: pubmed-database
skills.description: Search PubMed only.

skills.name: semanticscholar-skill
skills.description: Search Semantic Scholar only.

skills.name: literature-search-crossref
skills.description: Search Crossref publication metadata only. Useful for broad DOI and bibliographic coverage; abstracts may be sparse.

skills.name: literature-search-arxiv
skills.description: Search arXiv preprints only. Useful for recent technical work; results are not necessarily peer reviewed.

skills.name: langgraph-human-in-the-loop
skills.description: Human approval and resume design guidance implemented by local sessions.

skills.name: present-plan
skills.description: Present a completed, implementation-ready plan for user approval. Do not use for clarification questions or incomplete drafts.

skills.name: workflow-orchestration-patterns
skills.description: Bounded workflow and retry design guidance.

skills.name: file-upload-router
skills.description: Register and route local research files.

skills.name: workflow-visualizer-dashboard
skills.description: Render terminal status and structured workflow traces.

skills.name: rag-vector-knowledge-base
skills.description: Build or query a local sparse TF-IDF research index.

skills.name: recursive-search-controller
skills.description: Bound repeated API search and query expansion using runtime configuration and evidence-based stop reasons.

skills.name: gbt7714-strict-rules
skills.description: Local GB/T 7714 profiles, validation rules, and CSL evidence.

skills.name: model-call-logger
skills.description: Sanitized append-only model call logging.

skills.name: quality-audit
skills.description: Explain request counts, source failures, screening counts, stop reasons, and relevant logs.

skills.name: workspace-files
skills.description: Safely list, read, search, copy, move, write, or reversibly delete files inside this workspace.

skills.name: open-access-paper-download
skills.description: Download only verified open-access PDF URLs from the active paper pool and preserve a provenance manifest.

skills.name: open-access-reading-copy
skills.description: Create a clearly labelled reading-copy DOCX from downloaded open-access PDFs; it is never presented as publisher Word.

skills.name: opencli-search
skills.description: Search any website through an OpenCLI adapter. Consult the opencli-usage and smart-search skills to discover available adapters and select the best one for each query.

skills.name: run-code
skills.description: Execute Python code for data analysis, statistical tests, scientific computing, plotting, and any custom computation. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

skills.name: web-fetch
skills.description: Fetch content from a URL. Saves PDFs to disk, returns text for web pages. Use to download papers from direct links or read full web page content.

skills.name: git
skills.description: Version control with git. Run init, add, commit, log, diff, status, checkout, branch in the working directory.

skills.name: office-to-md
skills.description: Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, audio to Markdown using markitdown. Provide the file path to convert.

skills.name: md-to-office
skills.description: Convert Markdown to DOCX, PPTX, PDF, HTML, EPUB, LaTeX using Pandoc. Provide path or text, and target_format.

skills.name: shell
skills.description: Run a shell command and return stdout, stderr, and exit code. Use for system tasks, file operations, or any CLI tool.

skills.name: officecli
skills.description: Create, read, edit, and validate Office documents (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) via officecli. Single binary, no Office installation required. Consult the officecli SKILL.md for full capability reference.
